summary: Kartoon Studios filed an 8-K/A to correct a settlement amount in a previously disclosed litigation settlement. The company reported that on June 11, 2026, it entered into a settlement agreement receiving $50,000,000 (corrected from $5M) from a settling party in the Augenbaum v. Anson Investments Master Fund LP case. The court approved the settlement. The action continues against two remaining defendants. This is a litigation-related event, not a special situation classified category.
